newsitem.title: GERMANY: German March motor vehicle production down 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: German March motor vehicle production down 5 pct.

text.p: German motor vehicle production fell five percent year-on-year in March and car production also fell five percent, the VDA Automobile Industry Association said on Wednesday.
Domestic incoming orders for cars rose nine percent in March year-on-year and rose 16 percent from the previous month on a seasonally-adjusted basis, the VDA said.
